chapters.title: The Bridge That Bites
chapters.opening_condition: The Ember Vault drops beneath one chain bridge; Elian and Mira are tiny adult silhouettes crossing toward the sealed bell lift.
chapters.closing_turn: The lift closes on a new Ledger offer: choose a class and reach the Hollow Meridian crown before the Bell Regent ascends.

chapters.title: Choose the Crack
chapters.zone: Ember Vault Chainworks and bell lift
chapters.opening_condition: The bell lift opens into vast Chainworks where suspended gears and three broken spans frame a narrow route downward.
chapters.closing_turn: Quest completion, Free Delvers reputation, inventory, and 130/140 XP reconcile in a compact end-state menu.

chapters.title: Breath Has Teeth
chapters.opening_condition: The Glass Gallery descends through dark mineral ribs and pale echo planes toward a brass survey vestibule.
chapters.closing_turn: Level 5, 85/190 XP, Seed III, zero Qi, injuries, loot, and quest completion reconcile before the descent.

chapters.title: The Wrong Victory
chapters.opening_condition: A monumental oxidized gate overlooks the Verdigris Sump, with one moving ivory seal suspended above dark teal water.
chapters.closing_turn: The end-state Ledger records 12/62 HP, 2/58 Qi, quest failure, faction shifts, and no unearned level-up.

chapters.title: Inventory of Ash
chapters.opening_condition: An abandoned kiln refuge surrounds the injured party with one cold forge, simple shelves, and broad charcoal walls.
chapters.closing_turn: The final status holds at L5 165/190 XP with Breath Deviation, repaired loadouts, and no false cultivation gain.

chapters.title: Verdigris Sump
chapters.opening_condition: The Verdigris Sump opens around towering oxidized pumps, dark teal water, and one pale pump heart far below.
chapters.closing_turn: Quest ADVANCED, 70/250 XP, Free Delvers reputation, filters, skills, and pump state reconcile.

chapters.title: Rift Temperer
chapters.opening_condition: The lower Verdigris sluice hangs beneath a cracked ceiling, with the pump heart visible through one distant arch.
chapters.closing_turn: L6 210/250 XP, Channel I, Rift Temperer, new gear, faction gain, and environmental loss reconcile.

chapters.title: The Guild's Short Cut
chapters.opening_condition: The Resonance Cistern forms a vast brass throat above deep green water, with Sable alone on the opposite ring.
chapters.closing_turn: Rescue completes, hidden conspiracy advances, factions shift, and L7 170/320 XP reconciles.

chapters.title: Crownshaft Assault
chapters.opening_condition: The Crownshaft forge hangs beside a seemingly endless ivory lift spine, with the Bell Regent's yoke far above.
chapters.closing_turn: Strike the Silence replaces the incomplete assault: defeat the Regent before it reaches the public lift.

chapters.title: Strike the Silence
chapters.zone: Bell Regent chamber and public lift
chapters.opening_condition: The Bell Regent towers through the final chamber, four long legs spanning ivory platforms above the public lift cable.
chapters.closing_turn: A CH01→CH10 comparison closes over the surviving lift as the sealed fourth-meridian door opens behind the adult party.
